name: Forge Barcode Fulfilment Manager for WooCommerce – Order Scanner & PDF Invoices
author: forgecreative

sections.description:
Forge Barcode Fulfilment Manager gives a WooCommerce store the barcode and order
fulfilment tools a small warehouse actually needs. Every new order gets its own QR
code. Your staff scan that code on a simple front-end page, the order is looked up
and previewed, and its status advances in one tap. Any order can be printed as a
branded PDF invoice.

Barcodes and QR codes

  • Generates a QR code automatically for every new WooCommerce order.
  • The barcode value encodes the WooCommerce order ID, so one scan resolves straight
    to the right order.
  • Optionally attaches the QR code image to your WooCommerce order emails.
  • Admin metabox on the order screen showing the barcode image, with a one-click
    regenerate button.

Order scanning

  • A front-end scanner page via the [forge_ops_scanner] shortcode, restricted to
    users who can manage WooCommerce.
  • Works with USB and handheld barcode readers — the keyboard-wedge kind that type
    what they scan — and with manual entry when you would rather key an order number
    in by hand.
  • The scanner looks the order up, previews it, and advances its status (to
    processing or completed, for example) in a single tap.
  • Configurable per-status scanning workflow, plus an optional auto-complete
    countdown.
  • REST endpoints (forge-ops/v1/order-preview, forge-ops/v1/scan) protected by
    capability and nonce checks.

PDF invoices

  • Branded PDF invoice generated on demand for any order.
  • Print Invoice and Mark Complete buttons on every row of the WooCommerce Orders
    screen.
  • Signed download links, plus a Download Invoice action in My Account > Orders so
    customers can fetch their own invoices.
  • Invoice metabox on the order edit screen.

All generated files are stored in unguessable, per-site upload directories and
served only through signed handlers, so customer documents are not publicly
enumerable.

Who this is for

Small and mid-size WooCommerce stores that pick and pack their own orders:
warehouse and dispatch teams working down a queue of orders, a one-person operation
at a packing bench, click-and-collect counters checking orders in, and anyone
currently reading order numbers off a screen and typing them into a search box. If
your staff handle the same orders every day, one scan per order is quicker than
hunting for it.

Premium (Forge Barcode Fulfilment Manager Pro add-on)

The following are provided by the separate Pro add-on and are not included in this
free plugin:

  • Code128 and other non-QR barcode formats.
  • Automatic invoice generation when an order reaches completed.
  • Bulk invoice actions on the Orders screen, and the email-attachment engine that
    chooses which WooCommerce emails carry the invoice.
  • Additional documents: packing slip, delivery note, dispatch label and shipping label.
  • A6 combined order label (barcode + address + item list).
  • Extra scan actions (mark dispatched, add order notes, print documents on scan).
  • Scan history log with per-order timeline, filterable admin log and CSV export.
sections.installation:
This package is self-contained — all PHP libraries are bundled, so no Composer or
npm step is required.

  1. In wp-admin go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the
    forge-barcode-fulfilment-manager-for-woocommerce.zip file (or extract the forge-barcode-fulfilment-manager-for-woocommerce
    folder into wp-content/plugins/).
  2. Activate Forge Barcode Fulfilment Manager for WooCommerce from
    Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. WooCommerce must be active; if it is not, the plugin shows an admin notice and
    stays inactive.
  4. On first activation a setup wizard opens — follow it to confirm the barcode
    format, scan workflow, invoice branding and the page that hosts the scanner.
  5. All options can be changed later from the plugin’s settings screen under the
    WooCommerce menu.
sections.faq:
Is this an order fulfillment plugin for WooCommerce?

Yes. Whether you spell it fulfilment or fulfillment, this plugin covers the
warehouse side of a WooCommerce order: a scannable code on every order, a scanning
page your staff can work through, order statuses that advance as orders are
handled, and a PDF invoice you can print for any order.

What barcode format does the free plugin generate?

QR codes. Every new WooCommerce order gets a QR code encoding its order ID. Code128
and other linear barcode formats are provided by the Pro add-on.

Do I need a special barcode scanner?

Any USB or handheld barcode reader that acts as a keyboard will work — that covers
most inexpensive readers. The scanner page simply receives what the reader types.
You can also type an order number in manually, so you can test the whole workflow
before buying any hardware.

Can I scan orders with my phone camera?

Not in this version. The scanner page does not use your device camera, so it needs
a hardware barcode reader or manual entry. The page itself is a normal front-end
page, so it loads fine on a phone or tablet if you have a reader paired to it.

Which order statuses can the scanner set?

You choose. The settings screen maps scanning to your WooCommerce order statuses —
for example moving orders to processing when they are picked and completed when they
go out — and there is an optional auto-complete countdown for a single-step
workflow.

How do I add the scanner to a page?

Place the [forge_ops_scanner] shortcode on any page (Gutenberg Shortcode block,
Classic editor, or an Elementor shortcode/HTML widget). Only users who can manage
WooCommerce can use it. The setup wizard can create this page for you.

Do I need Composer or npm to install this?

No. The distribution ZIP bundles all required PHP libraries (mPDF, endroid/qr-code,
picqer/php-barcode-generator). Just upload and activate.

Which languages do the PDFs support?

This build bundles the DejaVu font family, which covers Latin, Western European,
Cyrillic and Greek scripts. Characters outside those scripts (e.g. CJK, Arabic,
Indic) will not render on generated PDFs in this build.

Where are generated files stored?

In per-site, unguessably-named subdirectories of the uploads folder. Invoices are
served only through signed download handlers.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Documentation: corrected the feature list. Code128 barcodes, automatic invoice
    generation on order completion, bulk invoice actions and the email-attachment
    engine are Pro add-on features and were previously listed as if included in the
    free plugin. The free plugin generates QR codes.
  • Documentation: removed a bulk barcode generation tool from the feature list; the
    free plugin does not provide one.
  • Documentation: expanded the readme with clearer use cases and new FAQs.
  • Internal version constant bumped to match the plugin header, so browsers
    re-fetch the plugin’s CSS and JavaScript once. No other functional changes.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: barcode generation, front-end order scanning workflow, branded
    PDF invoices, admin settings and setup wizard.
